WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "sale_id" AS "SALE_ID"
    FROM "shop"."main"."sales"
  ),
  "menura_2_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "SALE_ID"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE "SALE_ID" IS NOT NULL
  ),
  "menura_3_aggregate" AS (
    SELECT
      "SALE_ID" AS "SALE_ID",
      CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS "menura.row_count"
    FROM "menura_2_filter"
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  "menura_4_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "SALE_ID",
      "menura.row_count"
    FROM "menura_3_aggregate"
    WHERE "menura.row_count" > 1
  ),
  "menura_5_project" AS (
    SELECT
      "SALE_ID" AS "SALE_ID",
      "menura.row_count" AS "row_count"
    FROM "menura_4_filter"
  )
SELECT
  "SALE_ID",
  "row_count"
FROM "menura_5_project"

WITH
  "menura_1_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "sale_id" AS "SALE_ID"
    FROM "shop"."main"."returns"
  ),
  "menura_2_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "SALE_ID"
    FROM "menura_1_scan"
    WHERE "SALE_ID" IS NOT NULL
  ),
  "menura_3_scan" AS (
    SELECT
      "sale_id" AS "RETURNS_SALES.SALE_ID"
    FROM "shop"."main"."sales"
  ),
  "menura_4_join" AS (
    SELECT
      "SALE_ID",
      "RETURNS_SALES.SALE_ID"
    FROM "menura_2_filter"
    LEFT JOIN "menura_3_scan" ON "menura_2_filter"."SALE_ID" = "menura_3_scan"."RETURNS_SALES.SALE_ID"
  ),
  "menura_5_filter" AS (
    SELECT
      "SALE_ID",
      "RETURNS_SALES.SALE_ID"
    FROM "menura_4_join"
    WHERE "RETURNS_SALES.SALE_ID" IS NULL
  ),
  "menura_6_project" AS (
    SELECT
      "SALE_ID" AS "SALE_ID"
    FROM "menura_5_filter"
  )
SELECT
  "SALE_ID"
FROM "menura_6_project"
